instrument: Perpres 10/2021 Pasal 3 ayat (1) huruf d + ayat (2), as amended by Perpres 49/2021
population: The canonical records the Perpres partition leaves RESIDUAL — bucket `residual-besar-observed` of scripts/kbli_filiera/perpres_body_default_relation.py (879 records, TERBUKA/100/declared_gap) — narrowed to the Bali axis ATTENZIONE_FASCIA_BALI (l4_bali.blocked false): the applied 2026 Bali closure overlay's static 'not among the 18 closed fields, verify on OSS' flag (`scripts/kbli_filiera/_l4bali_basis.py`, `NON_RISK_DERIVED_STATUSES`), the class Lot 1's own dossier arithmetic deferred as `bali_attenzione_fascia`. Measured on the canonical 2026-09-21: 272 bucket members carry that Bali status BEFORE the `no_legacy_pma_prose` predicate — the 2026-09-19 scoreboard's prior — but the compiler's own answer, re-derived through the whole rule, is 271: code 62900 carries `pma_nota`/`pma_prioritas` and is deferred to the legacy-prose lot instead, the same class Lot 1 deferred 36 codes to. Of the 271 the rule reaches, 260 ship here and 11 are withheld: 6 on an adjudicated 4-digit sibling (`adjudicated_sibling`: 16222, 21023, 32202, 59132, 91112, 91122), 4 on an unswept sector statute (`unswept_sector_statute`, divisions 35/49/52: 35133, 35159, 49297, 52213), 1 on the Pasal 11(2) finance/banking referral (`instrument_referral`, division 64: 64210), 0 on a hand-excluded body-stated category (all 19 of Lot 1's `excluded_codes` carry Bali status OK_or_HIGHER_RISK, verified per code — none reaches this lot's ATTENZIONE_FASCIA_BALI axis, so none is carried forward) and 0 on an annex title collision (all 9 catalogue-wide collisions — the same census Lot 1 measured, unchanged, because the collision test reads only `judul` and Lampiran III and does not depend on the Bali axis a lot cuts on — also carry Bali status OK_or_HIGHER_RISK; the probe stays armed for a later lot but proves nothing for this one). Every one of those figures is re-derived on each run and refused on any drift; none is a stored count.
adjudicated: 2026-09-18 — dossier research/kbli/2026-09-18-kbli-codes-closed-to-pma-tier1-tier2-dossier.md §8.5 (the four-way partition, read verbatim) and §8.5 (whole-catalogue residual-open relabel, owner decision); Zero's go the same day, in lots with a gate. 2026-09-21 — Zero's mandate 'tutto' (ship every remaining lot of the residual-open lane), which is why lot 2 — the ATTENZIONE_FASCIA_BALI band Lot 1 named and deferred — follows without a fresh per-lot go.
decisive_test: Absence, re-derived from the instrument on every run by perpres_body_default_relation.report() and refused on any set difference in EITHER direction — identical to lot 1: Pasal 3(1)(d) is residual to 3(1)(a)-(c), so membership is exactly 'no annex row, no body article, no sector-law carve-out'; Pasal 3(2) supplies the verdict ('dapat diusahakan oleh semua Penanam Modal') and the canonical already publishes it (TERBUKA/100) — this spec relabels the VERIFICATION state only, on the members whose Bali overlay reads ATTENZIONE_FASCIA_BALI, and it never flips a verdict, a cap, or the Bali flag itself. Relabelling `pma_verification_status: declared_gap -> located` is what makes `discloseBaliL4` disclose the Bali row for the first time (module docstring, 'WHY A LOT'): before this lot the row is withheld entirely (national tuple unlocated, and ATTENZIONE_FASCIA_BALI is not a sourced CHIUSO_BALI closure so `isSourcedBaliClosure` never overrides that withholding); after it the row reads 'Not on Bali's PMA closure list — verify on OSS' verbatim — a static flag, never a closure or a risk-derived verdict.
what_this_rests_on_and_does_not_prove: It rests on the three annex parsers and the BPS 2020->2025 crosswalk being complete: a code wrongly missing from a Lampiran II/III row would be relabelled open here, exactly as lot 1. It does NOT prove the absence of a SECTOR statute outside the Perpres for the 4 codes divisions 35/49/52 withhold on that basis, nor for the 260 shipped — the sectoral sweep covered the carve-out list and the dossier's named classes, not all 1,559 codes — and the basis string says so. It says nothing about OSS licensing (risk tier, scale, zoning) nor about the Pasal 7(1) >Rp10bn Usaha Besar test a particular PMA must meet. The Pasal 2(2) category legs rest on the same COARSE, fail-closed substring probe lot 1 measured (`category_closure_probe`) — catalogue-wide and unchanged by the Bali axis, so its 4-code census (all division 20, none in this lot's reach) refuses the whole run if it drifts. It additionally does NOT say anything about the ATTENZIONE_FASCIA_BALI flag's OWN basis: that flag is a static 'verify on OSS' marker computed by `cure_l4bali_applied_closure.py` from (bps_2020_ancestors + the excluded-19 set), not a risk-derived verdict (`_l4bali_basis.py`'s `NON_RISK_DERIVED_STATUSES`) — this spec does not touch it, confirm it, revoke it, or explain it; it only makes the NATIONAL tuple locatable enough for the disclosure gate to show that flag to a reader for the first time.

sector_referral.why: «Perizinan berusaha dan pelaksanaan kegiatan dalam rangka Penanaman Modal untuk Bidang Usaha keuangan dan Bidang Usaha perbankan dilaksanakan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan di bidangnya masing-masing» — the Perpres hands the whole finance/banking sector to its own legislation, so absence from its annexes is evidence that the instrument never reached the code, NOT that the code is open. data/kbli-filiera/sector-law-carveout.json carries this text verbatim yet enumerates only six insurance codes (65111 65112 65121 65122 65201 65202): that is the same UNDER-match one level up (superscar #3), because the referral's unit is the sector the article names, not the six codes somebody listed under it. Without this leg the lot shipped 64121 — conventional commercial banking — as residual-open with a verified 100% cap, under a basis string that asserts «no Pasal 11(2) sector-law carve-out reaches it».

sector_referral.instrument: UU 22/2001 Migas · UU 30/2009 Ketenagalistrikan · UU 17/2008 Pelayaran · UU 1/2009 Penerbangan · UU 38/2009 Pos · UU 36/1999 Telekomunikasi
sector_referral.why: Energy, transport, logistics and telecommunications carry foreign-ownership provisions in statutes OUTSIDE the Perpres, and this lane swept the Perpres annexes only. The basis string already declares that gap — but declaring a gap is not a licence to publish a VERIFIED 100% cap over it, and `pma_cap_verified` is exactly what a client reads as the percentage. This is OUR caution, not the instrument's: nothing here asserts these codes are closed, they stay `declared_gap` until a lane actually reads the statute. MEASURED, not assumed: the canonical already carries 23 located TERBATAS/49% caps in these divisions (50111-50135, 50211-50223, 51101 51102, 53200, Perpres 10/2021 and 49/2021 Lampiran III), so the residual codes here sit beside an adjudicated cap — and the 4-digit sibling leg cannot see it, because 5011/5012/5013 are capped while 5014 is not: sea transport was withheld at 50127/50139 and would have shipped at 50143 50144 50145 50149. The unit is therefore the DIVISION. Divisions 09 35 49 52 61 carry no adjudicated cap in the canonical today; they are withheld under the same principle rather than on their own evidence, because the sweep that would tell them apart is exactly the one this lane did not run.

category_closure_probe.article: Perpres 10/2021 Pasal 2 ayat (2) huruf e + huruf f (carrying UU 25/2007 Pasal 12 ayat (2) huruf e/f as replaced by UU 6/2023 Pasal 77 item 2)
category_closure_probe.category: «industri pembuatan senjata kimia» and «industri bahan kimia industri dan industri bahan perusak lapisan ozon» — a closure stated by ACTIVITY, with no KBLI code named anywhere in the article
category_closure_probe.finding: Measured on the canonical 2026-09-21: the state marks this category per code in its OWN licensing rows — the persyaratan «Melampirkan Surat Pernyataan tidak memproduksi senjata kimia dan industri yang menghasilkan Bahan Perusak Ozon/BPO» / «Menjamin kegiatan usaha tidak menghasilkan produk … senjata kimia dan/atau bahan perusak ozon» — and it lands on exactly four codes, catalogue-wide and unchanged from lot 1: 20115, 20116, 20119, 20121. All four are TERBUKA/100 already and none carries Bali status ATTENZIONE_FASCIA_BALI, so lot 2's rule cannot reach any of them either — not because this spec excluded them, but because the Perpres partition and the Bali axis both place them elsewhere. Of the 37 KBLI-2025 codes in division 20 this lot ships 4 (20123 20213 20233 20234) and NOT ONE carries the marker. What this does NOT prove: the marker is a PP 28/2025 licensing condition, not a statutory enumeration, so a code without it could still HOST the closed activity — which is what «closed by activity» means. The verdict this lot writes is provenance only: all 4 were already TERBUKA/100 in the canonical before it and are TERBUKA/100 after it. Carried forward from lot 1 (raised by kimi-code/k3 HIGH (3), council round 1) rather than re-litigated, because the marker census is catalogue-wide and does not depend on the Bali axis a lot cuts on.

annex_title_collision_probe.annex: Perpres 10/2021 Lampiran III — persyaratan tertentu, the foreign-ownership caps
annex_title_collision_probe.why: Absence from Lampiran III is matched by CODE, through the BPS 2020->2025 crosswalk. BPS also RE-SCOPES numbers between vintages, and where it does, the two matchings disagree: the cap follows the activity the annex names, the crosswalk follows the number. 2020-58120 was «Penerbitan Direktori dan Mailing List» and 2020-58130 was the press row; in 2025 the two swapped and 58120 IS «Penerbitan Surat Kabar». The code therefore passed an absence test it should have failed, and lot 1 shipped it TERBUKA with a VERIFIED 100% cap over Lampiran III entry #33, which reads 0% at establishment (49% via the capital market for expansion only). Found by the on-disk gate on the first candidate (PR #6783, REWORK-BUILD) — the class was invisible to every leg the compiler had, because each of them reasons about the code NUMBER.
annex_title_collision_probe.scope: Lampiran III only. It is the one annex carrying a `foreign_cap_pct`, so a hit is a cap this lane would be contradicting rather than a partnership condition. Lampiran I's artifact (perpres-priority-codes.json) holds codes and no titles, so the test cannot run there at all; Lampiran II (perpres-umkm-reservation.json) carries an OCR-uncorroborated row whose entire text is «Industri» (10721, title_corroborated false), which matches every industrial title in the catalogue and produced 82% of the raw hits when the probe was measured across all three annexes.
annex_title_collision_probe.finding: Measured on the canonical 2026-09-21: the same census lot 1 measured, unchanged — the collision test reads only a code's `judul` against the Lampiran III `bidang_usaha` text, neither of which depends on the Bali axis a lot cuts on — fires on the same 9 of 1,559: 50112, 50122, 50123, 50124, 50126, 50133, 50143, 53200, 58120. All 9 carry Bali status OK_or_HIGHER_RISK, verified per code, so NONE falls inside this lot's ATTENZIONE_FASCIA_BALI reach. The probe is armed and refuses the run on any drift, exactly as lot 1, but for THIS lot it is proving nothing — the honest report the compiler itself prints ('annex title collision: 0 of the reach') rather than a coincidence to paper over. Cost of the leg to lot 2: zero members.

sector_law_closures.instrument: UU 40/1999 Pers · UU 32/2002 Penyiaran · UU 30/2004 Jabatan Notaris
sector_law_closures.why: Four codes whose own sector statute closes or hard-caps foreign ownership, none of which any Perpres leg can see: 58120 «Penerbitan Surat Kabar» (press, UU 40/1999 — and Lampiran III #33 prices the same activity at 0% at establishment); 60101 «Aktivitas Penyiaran Radio Analog» and 60201 the television twin (UU 32/2002 Penyiaran, whose foreign-capital regime is its own); 69104 Notaris/PPAT, an entity-form closure rather than a cap at all — a notaris is a *pejabat umum* appointed by the state, a role no PT PMA can hold. THIS BLOCK IS NOT A SUBTRACTION. The codes are out of the lot today for reasons unrelated to any of that — 58120 by the title-collision probe, the other three by the Bali overlay and eligibility filters — i.e. BY ACCIDENT, and an accident stops being protection the moment a later lot lifts the filter (lot 2 carries the ATTENZIONE_FASCIA_BALI class, lot 3 the BLOCCATO_DIPENDE_SCOPE one). So the compiler REFUSES the whole run if any of these is ever listed, or is ever reached with no leg holding it. A statute closure is an adjudication a human owes; it is deliberately not something this compiler may absorb silently. Raised by the on-disk gate on PR #6783 as the standing half of its BLOCK: «when the Bali cut is lifted the same rule reaches 69104 with nothing to stop it».
